name: Rectangular Pillow with Blossoming Lotus Decor
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；1191；Jin sancai (three-color) ware: brick-red earthenware with decoration incised and carved in an all-over coating of white slip under variegated lead-fluxed glazes on the top and with mold-impressed floral decoration under white slip and lead-fluxed, emerald-green glaze on the sides; with dated inscription brush-written in ink on the base after firing
